basis: Independent semantic dependency reasoning from frozen production-plan-v2 before upper-layer production or maintenance evaluation; not read from runtime plan output.
M2_rules: Unchanged valid inputs/recipe: no recipe callback; exact result identity retained.
Recipe input change is observed; source freshness alone cannot reuse an old receipt.
Receipt-only renewal with identical complete OwnershipResult stops downstream interpretation after local revalidation.
Same body with changed authority,validity,gaps or evidence is a new result and must propagate.
Navigation alone does not extend build closure.
Unavailable observations cause HOLD, not an empty worklist.
critical_failures: Unrelated result rebuilt solely due navigation
Stale or unreviewed source binding published current
Transport SHA reused as kernel input version
Native judge authority invented by a synthetic callback
evaluation_note: Any legitimate change in declared semantic dependencies must be independently reconciled before evaluation; never change expected answers to match observed engine output.
